title: Weave public authoring benchmark requirements
basis: Paraphrases of current public vendor marketing/FAQ, not independent product testing or private feature documentation.

requirements.vendorPublicClaim: Source information, documents and teams remain connected across program work.
requirements.concept2cureAcceptance: Upload/ingest controlled source versions, select admitted project evidence, preserve exact citations/spans and source hashes in saved prose, and expose changed/unread inputs.
existingOwners: authoring section evidence and drafting-source lineage
requirements.qualification: End-to-end current-source access/drift and saved-citation proof; homepage does not establish exact citation granularity.

requirements.vendorPublicClaim: Connected authoring spans IND/CTA/NDA/BLA and named clinical, nonclinical and CMC documents.
requirements.concept2cureAcceptance: Each relevant US filing and reusable document must select its actual outline, scope and manual/narrative policy, then create/edit/reopen/source-review/export through one editor.
requirements.qualification: A registry/blueprint/template count is not completed workflow coverage.

requirements.vendorPublicClaim: AI assists drafting, review, verification and source retrieval; humans retain final responsibility.
requirements.concept2cureAcceptance: AnA can prepare supported narrative, propose tracked changes, review the exact saved section, preserve source attribution and refuse original-record/statistical fabrication; changes stay versioned and reviewable.
requirements.qualification: Scripted provider fixtures do not establish live model factual accuracy or human expert quality.

requirements.vendorPublicClaim: Teams can reuse connected content across application types and jurisdictions while carrying context forward.
requirements.concept2cureAcceptance: Reuse actual controlled source/previous document versions while retaining parent and child template identity, product/filing/jurisdiction context, permissions, evidence gaps and change history.
requirements.qualification: Copied text alone is not connected reuse; source drift and new-target scope must be proved.

requirements.vendorPublicClaim: Team collaboration and review stay connected to the program/dossier.
requirements.concept2cureAcceptance: Current project/section access, assignments, review requests/comments, revisions and independently governed signatures must work without parallel authoring surfaces.
requirements.qualification: Team names or static task blueprints do not prove live collaboration, conflict handling or access safety.

requirements.vendorPublicClaim: HAQ Manager provides question intake, collaboration/tracking and response generation.
requirements.concept2cureAcceptance: Admit current letter visibility, extract/retain exact questions, assign/track them, draft and amend in the sole editor, then explicitly write the exact saved response revision back through the existing governed writer before approval/package generation.
requirements.qualification: Import-only reachability does not update response_text or preserve question-signature validity automatically.

requirements.vendorPublicClaim: Submission Builder supports named submissions, briefing books, annual reports and amendments across the lifecycle.
requirements.concept2cureAcceptance: Project filing guidance must lead to applicable documents and source needs; packaging/validation and real agency delivery must remain separate measurable functions.
requirements.qualification: The public homepage does not establish direct agency transmission or every formatting/technical standard; do not use it to invent a comparative winner.

requirements.vendorPublicClaim: Vendor states encryption, SAML-compatible SSO, MFA, role-based access, monitoring, segregated customer environments and no LLM-provider data retention/training.
requirements.concept2cureAcceptance: Measure actual access isolation, authentication, source privacy, audit, provider configuration/contracts and operational evidence for Concept2Cure.
requirements.qualification: Vendor statements are not independent audit evidence, and Concept2Cure cannot inherit the vendor's security or privacy claims.

requirements.vendorPublicClaim: Homepage labels Program Planner as launching Q4 2026.
requirements.concept2cureAcceptance: Current project planning should be judged on its own reachable biotech workflows; any competitor planning comparison must distinguish announced from demonstrated/released capabilities.
requirements.qualification: Do not present this announced product as independently evaluated current functionality.

notEstablished: Live head-to-head performance, speed, accuracy or cost metrics.
Complete scope/depth of competitor templates, regulatory verification, citation granularity, document fidelity or direct agency transmission.
Concept2Cure feature maturity, compliance, security or superiority from source-code names, route counts or shared infrastructure.
comparisonRule: Do not claim parity or superiority until agreed workflow acceptance is demonstrated on each product or the comparison is clearly limited to verified public statements and separately qualified Concept2Cure behavior.
